literal: buy the box and give back the pearl
meaning_long: caring about the wrapping and missing what really matters
source: 《韩非子·外储说左上》 (public domain), retold in our own words.
cover: He bought the box…\Nand gave back the PEARL.
hook: He bought the box…\Nand gave back the PEARL.
meaning: = choosing the wrapping over the treasure
story: Ancient China, about 2,300 years ago. A jeweller from Chu has one perfect pearl. To sell it, he makes a gorgeous box for it: carved fragrant wood, green jade inlays, a golden clasp, even perfume. At the market a rich young buyer from Zheng falls in love with the box, pays the full price, opens it, takes the pearl out and hands the pearl back: he only wanted the box. The jeweller is left standing there, holding his pearl.
continuity: - THE JEWELLER: slim man about 50, neat grey topknot, long thin grey mustache, kind tired eyes, deep slate-blue robe with a dark sash.
- THE BUYER: young man about 25, round cheerful face, big sparkling eyes, wide smile, flamboyant rust-red silk robe with gold trim, a little jade hairpin in his topknot.

- THE BOX AND THE PEARL: one small square box of dark red carved wood with flowers and birds carved on it, green jade inlays and a small golden clasp (no characters, no writing); one large, perfectly round, shining white pearl.
- SETTING: the jeweller's simple wooden workshop, and a busy ancient market street with plain cloth awnings (no signs, no writing).
scenes: The twist (used as the hook, first frame of the video)

Medium shot, both faces clear. At the market stall, the buyer happily hugs the beautiful carved box to his chest with one arm, eyes closed in delight, while with his other hand he drops the shining pearl back into the jeweller's open palm. The jeweller stares at the pearl, jaw dropped, totally stunned. This is the most important image; the editor will push in on it.
Close-ish shot: in his workshop, the jeweller holds up the large shining white pearl between two fingers, admiring it, the pearl glowing softly. (Only the jeweller.)
The jeweller bends over his workbench carving the small wooden box with a tiny chisel, setting green jade pieces into it, wood shavings around him, concentrating hard. (Only the jeweller.)

The finished box sits open on a silk cloth on the workbench, the pearl resting inside, golden clasp shining, a little curl of perfume smoke rising. The jeweller looks at it, very proud. (Only the jeweller.)
At the market stall: the buyer leans in close to the box on the counter, eyes huge and sparkling, hands clasped together, completely in love with it. The jeweller stands behind the counter smiling.
The buyer pours a big handful of round bronze coins (plain, no characters) onto the counter, grinning. The jeweller's eyes go wide with happiness.
The buyer has opened the box and holds the pearl out between two fingers back to the jeweller with a friendly, cheerful smile, the box tucked under his other arm. The jeweller looks confused.
The pearl (background for the big title)

The shining white pearl lying alone on the plain wooden stall counter in the lower half of the frame. The upper half is a calm, plain market background with soft grey ink washes and almost nothing in it (we place the big title there). No people.

A modern living room: the same BUYER (round cheerful face, jade hairpin in his topknot) in a modern rust-red hoodie proudly hugs a big shiny empty gift box with a fancy ribbon, while the small actual gift lies forgotten in the waste bin beside him. The same JEWELLER (grey topknot, thin grey mustache) in a slate-blue cardigan facepalms. No text, no logos, no brand names.
lines: He paid for a treasure, and gave the treasure back.
A jeweller had one perfect pearl.
To sell it, he made a beautiful box.
A buyer fell in love at first sight.
Then he handed back the pearl. Just the box, thanks!
Buy the box, give back the pearl.
It means caring about the wrapping, not what's inside.
Like keeping the fancy box… and throwing out the gift.
title: He bought the box… and gave back the pearl 💎 | 买椟还珠
desc: 买椟还珠 (mǎi dú huán zhū) = caring about the wrapping, not what's inside. Ever done that? 👇
pinned: 买 buy · 椟 box · 还 return · 珠 pearl. 📝 只看包装不看内容，就是买椟还珠。(Zhǐ kàn bāozhuāng bú kàn nèiróng, jiù shì mǎi dú huán zhū.) = Judging only the packaging and not what's inside? That's buying the box and returning the pearl.
